rainbow-beach-1.name: Double Island Point

facts.what: Coastal headland, next headland north of Noosa, inside the Cooloola section of Great Sandy National Park, about 12 km south along the beach from Rainbow Beach; has the Double Island Point Lighthouse; Wolf Rock is four volcanic pinnacles offshore; named by Cook in 1770; Kabi Kabi country
facts.access_note: Reached by 4WD along the beach: a Cooloola Recreation Area vehicle access permit is required. QPWS 2026 closures list shows 'Natural Sand Movement and access to Double Island Point' 5 Dec 2025 to 5 Dec 2026 (via web search summary of parks.qld.gov.au; unverified on page)

cost.note: Spot itself charges nothing; vehicle access permit applies to driving there. Fee not verified: QPWS page https://parks.qld.gov.au/management/managed-areas/recreation/vehicle-permits is BLOCKED to scripts (third-party figures $14.40/day, ~$35.50/week not used). Orchestrator to confirm current Cooloola fee in browser, or choose open/free with the permit in bio.

whitsundays-10.name: South Molle Island

facts.what: Whitsunday island, 4.66 km2, highest point Mount Jeffreys (194 m), 16 km of walking and cycling tracks, most of it in Molle Islands National Park; popular walk to Mount Jeffreys and on to Sandy Bay
facts.resort_status: Resort at Bauer Bay was destroyed by Cyclone Debbie (2017) and as of Wikipedia's 2019 text remained closed; QPWS alert (via search summary, parks.qld.gov.au/park-alerts/26157) says the privately owned Bauer Bay jetty is closed to the public 30 Jan-31 Dec 2026 after Cyclone Koji, with walkers still able to use the designated path from Bauer Bay beach to the national park trails. Reopening not confirmed.

cost.note: National park walking; no entry fee found, QPWS Molle Islands page BLOCKED (https://parks.qld.gov.au/parks/molle-islands). Getting there (boat/seaplane) is transport, not the price.

townsville-1.name: Reef HQ Aquarium

facts.what: Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority's national education centre, opened June 1987, the world's largest living tropical reef aquarium; Wikipedia says 'was' the largest, with a turtle hospital
facts.status: CLOSED: the official site says the aquarium is being redeveloped, its fish and corals were relocated to AIMS, and 'a reopening date' depends on lease negotiation with the landholder. No reopening date.

cost.note: No current price: the aquarium is closed and the site lists none. Do not add a price.

townsville-2.name: Castle Hill

facts.what: Heritage-listed pink granite monolith (Indigenous name Cootharinga), 286 m, dominating Townsville's skyline; a 2.6 km bitumen road reaches Hynes Lookout on the second peak, with views over the city and Cleveland Bay to Magnetic Island; the Goat Track is a rough path of 758 stairs

cost.note: No fee mentioned in Wikipedia; public reserve, lookout and tracks

townsville-2.ticketUrl_note: No single official visitor site verified; Townsville City Council site (townsville.qld.gov.au) returned 403 captcha to scripts, so BLOCKED if the orchestrator wants a council page: https://www.townsville.qld.gov.au/about-townsville/attractions/castle-hill (a guess, not a verified page)

facts.what: Now named Queensland Museum Tropics, Townsville: galleries on World Heritage rainforests, the Great Barrier Reef and HMS Pandora, the ship sent to capture the Bounty mutineers
